obligations.definition: The complete native TLBuffer contains independent depth-two FIFOs for A requests from auto_in to auto_out and D responses from auto_out to auto_in, plus the original observational TileLink monitor. It has one clock and synchronous active-high reset, no top parameters, no combinational flow-through and no full-queue replacement path. Functional transformations operate per accepted beat, including multibeat messages. Legal active A messages use opcode 0/1/4 (PutFull/PutPartial/Get), param zero, source in {0..9,16,32..47}, size 0..6, address[12]=1 and address aligned to 2^size. Sizes above three span multiple 64-bit beats for writes and read responses. Get and PutFull use the exact addressed lane mask; PutPartial uses a subset, possibly zero. Get corrupt is zero; write corrupt is passed through. Match D source, size and acknowledgment opcode to the outstanding A transaction, preserve multibeat metadata, keep stalled payload stable and reuse sources only after completion. Native monitor assertions remain enabled.

obligations.definition: Each FIFO has two persistent payload slots. Its write position advances modulo two only on accepted input beats; its read position advances modulo two only on accepted output beats. Non-reset simultaneous enqueue/dequeue advances both. Output payload continuously reflects the slot at the current read position, even while empty; after removing the last beat, it can therefore switch to the other slot's retained or uninitialized data. Reset returns both positions to slot zero without clearing its payload. Numerical comparisons before a slot's first initialization are outside the required domain; do not infer payload-zeroing from reset or valid low.

A downstream port agent returns matching acknowledgment source/size/opcode only for accepted outgoing requests and provides independently generated response data. Independently stall each direction while the other progresses, then drive both directions together. Exercise sizes 4..6 with correct per-message beat counts and verify no loss/duplication/reordering.

R-dv-024-008.description: Initialize all native inputs, generate a 10 ns clock and synchronous reset, then initialize both payload slots before judging invalid payload numerically. Drive at falling edges; enforce the complete legal TileLink domain, source uniqueness, multibeat headers and stalled-payload retention. A downstream port agent returns matching acknowledgment source/size/opcode only for accepted outgoing requests and provides independently generated response data. Initialize two distinct payloads per FIFO, drain to empty and inspect read-slot payload, wrap and reset both positions, then capture during reset from a nonfull state. Keep unknown/uninitialized numerical values out of obligated comparisons.
